about: Public-domain (CC0) works in The Met's Open Access collection whose marks can be measured at full resolution, for calibrating the studio's media (docs/media-data.md, 'Calibration method'; tools/calibrate_media.py). Images are not versioned: download primaryImage (verified 2026-11-25), then measure crop_xywh (full-resolution px). Crops were chosen automatically (highest local detail energy away from the margins) and checked by eye on contact sheets. px_per_mm = image px / catalogued size; it is approximate where the photo includes mounts or frames.
source: The Met Collection API, https://collectionapi.metmuseum.org/public/collection/v1/objects/{id} (records and images CC0)

what_to_measure.oil: impasto ridges, bristle furrows, broken colour, glazes in darks (van der Goes, David: glaze reference)
what_to_measure.tempera_gold: hatched flesh modelling, gold leaf, punchwork, craquelure
what_to_measure.watercolour: wash edges (edge darkening), granulation, wet-in-wet blooms, dry-brush
what_to_measure.gouache: flat opaque fields, crisp edges, light over dark
what_to_measure.ink_brush: brush width along stroke, flying white, tone gradation, feathering on paper or silk
what_to_measure.charcoal: tooth speckle, smudged tone, eraser lifts (black chalk and Conte included, as catalogued)
what_to_measure.graphite: hatching, line width, tooth fill, sheen not visible in diffuse photography
what_to_measure.pastel: broken colour over tooth, hatching, paper tone showing
what_to_measure.ukiyoe: keyline width, flat fields with baren mottle and wood grain, bokashi gradients, registration
what_to_measure.pen_illustration: line width and its variation along a line, free-end taper, hatch spacing, crossing angle and cross-hatched share per value band, ink and paper colour (tools/calibrate_media.py refs pen_illustration --kind line --file this file)
what_to_measure.engraving: burin line width, swell and taper, hatch spacing, crossing angle, cross-hatched share per value band (--kind line)
what_to_measure.etching: needle line width (bite), its spread (p90 / median), hatch spacing and crossings per value band, ink colour (--kind line)

about_by_group.pen_illustration: Public-domain (CC0) pen-and-ink illustration drawings, c. 1880-1911, at The Met, for calibrating the ink medium's pen (studio/v8/media/ink.py). Images are not versioned: download primaryImage, measure crop_xywh (full-resolution px). px_per_mm = image px / the catalogued size that best fits the photo's aspect; crops chosen automatically (local detail in mid values, away from margins) and checked by eye. Drawings for process reproduction were made 1.5-4x larger than printed (Harper 1894), so these are drawing-scale marks.
about_by_group.engraving: Public-domain (CC0) intaglio prints at The Met for calibrating the ink medium's burin, etching needle and print finish (studio/v8/media/ink.py): burin engravings 1512-1598 and etchings (some with drypoint) c. 1667-1900. Images are not versioned: download primaryImage, measure crop_xywh (full-resolution px). px_per_mm = image px / the catalogued size (plate or sheet) that best fits the photo's aspect; crops chosen automatically (local detail in mid values, away from margins) and checked by eye.
about_by_group.etching: Public-domain (CC0) intaglio prints at The Met for calibrating the ink medium's burin, etching needle and print finish (studio/v8/media/ink.py): burin engravings 1512-1598 and etchings (some with drypoint) c. 1667-1900. Images are not versioned: download primaryImage, measure crop_xywh (full-resolution px). px_per_mm = image px / the catalogued size (plate or sheet) that best fits the photo's aspect; crops chosen automatically (local detail in mid values, away from margins) and checked by eye.
